_doc: Recipe per GPU architecture, read by install.sh (and oh_my_mlip.recipes).
An arch NOT listed here uses the base recipe envs/<env>.yml if it is at or below 'base_max_arch';
above it, install.sh stops before building: no recipe has been checked for that GPU.
For a listed arch: {'recipe': '<stem>'} builds envs/<stem>.yml (sidecar envs/<stem>.build.sh,
lock envs/locks/<stem>.*.txt) into envs/<env>/; {'recipe': null, 'reason': ...} = unsupported on
that arch (install.sh stops with the reason); an env missing from the arch block = not checked (stop).
This table says which recipe to build, not that it works: per-arch validation is
models.json 'arch_validation', set only after setup_verify passes on that GPU.
